subject: Malaysia M-510 pigment for Basin's coating development
body:
Basin's wood-coating range includes NO VISIBLE OIL HPU-5001 varnish.

For opaque-coating development, we offer Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2. Its TDS lists water-based wall latex paints and zirconium/aluminium surface treatment; this is separate from clear-varnish applications.

If your team also develops opaque coatings, may I send the M-510 technical sheet to the relevant formulation team?
